'''Relay Station ADU-1104''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] communications station established by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on one of [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar's]] moons. It was still operational as of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].
